response:
当 a=4、b=1 且启用偏移时，x=5 处的 y 为 4×5+1=21；关闭偏移则变为 20。下方界面可本地调整这些参数，曲线与表格会同步重采样。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[note,form,result,chart,table,ask,reset], gap="medium")
$useOffset: boolean = true
$a: number = 4
$b: number = 1
let yAt5 = $a * 5 + ($useOffset ? $b : 0)
let points = @sample(x => $a * x + ($useOffset ? $b : 0), 0, 5, 6)
note = Callout(title="合成数学示例", tone="info", text="本界面中的参数、曲线与表格均为本地生成的合成数学示例数据，仅用于演示。")
form = Form(title="参数", children=[aInput,bInput,toggle])
aInput = Slider(label="a（斜率）", bind=$a, min=0, max=10, step=1)
bInput = NumberField(label="b（偏移量）", bind=$b, visible=$useOffset, required=true, step=1)
toggle = Switch(label="使用偏移 b", bind=$useOffset)
result = Metric(label="x = 5 时的 y", value=yAt5, unit="u", digits=2)
chart = Chart(kind="line", data=points, x="x", y=["y"], title="合成函数 y = a·x + (useOffset ? b : 0)", xLabel="x", yLabel="y")
table = DataTable(data=points, rowKey="x", columns=[{"key":"x","label":"x"},{"key":"y","label":"y"}], pageSize=10)
ask = Button(label="准备解释草稿", form=form, action=Ask(text="请解释这些参数如何影响 x=5 处的结果以及曲线形状。", context={"a":$a,"b":$b,"useOffset":$useOffset,"yAt5":yAt5}))
reset = Button(label="本地重置", action=Reset(), variant="plain")
```

调整参数后点击“准备解释草稿”只会生成一条可编辑的草稿，不会自动发送；重置仅恢复本地默认值（a=4、b=1、启用偏移）。
